players.name: Baker Mayfield
players.note: He was upgraded to limited practice on Thursday, Nov. 19, after missing Wednesday with foot and thumb injuries, and a Tampa Bay Times reporter said he looked fine and is trending toward playing Sunday at Detroit. He remains questionable pending the final report.

players.name: Joe Burrow
players.note: He missed stretching at Thursday's practice (Nov. 19) with an illness the team didn't specify, and one report called it minor. Cincinnati plays Monday, Nov. 23, vs. Washington, so his official designation comes later.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.note: He did not practice Nov. 18-19 with a hamstring strain and is expected to miss Week 11 vs. San Francisco in Mexico City. Minnesota is targeting a Week 12 return.

players.name: Kirk Cousins
players.note: He is in line to start Week 11 vs. San Francisco in Mexico City because Kyler Murray (hamstring) has not practiced. Murray is targeting Week 12, so this is a one-week streaming role.

players.name: Carson Beck
players.note: Sleeper's depth chart now has him as ARI's backup QB as of 10:50 PM PT Nov 21.

players.name: Drake Maye
players.note: He is out indefinitely with a right-ankle injury that NFL Network reported is believed to be a fracture that could end his season, and no surgery decision had been announced as of Nov. 17. Mike Vrabel doesn't expect him back for the Nov. 29 game after the bye.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.note: He missed Week 10 with quad and rib injuries. Seattle is on bye in Week 11, so Week 12 is the earliest he can return.

players.name: Drew Lock
players.note: He would keep starting in Week 12 if Sam Darnold (quad, ribs) is still out after Seattle's Week 11 bye. He threw for 240 yards and 2 TDs in Week 10.

players.name: Jacoby Brissett
players.note: He remains Baltimore's starter with Lamar Jackson on IR. He threw for 340 yards on Nov. 16 vs. the Chargers.

players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.note: He remains on IR after surgery on his right thumb and is likely out for the season. Jacoby Brissett is starting.

players.name: Jalen Hurts
players.note: He remains on IR with blood clots and is expected to miss the rest of 2026.

players.name: Jaxson Dart
players.note: He remains on IR and is reported to be out for the season. J.J. McCarthy is the Giants' starter.

players.name: Malik Willis
players.note: Miami placed him on IR on Nov. 10 with a groin/core-muscle injury, so he will miss at least four games. Kyle McCord is starting.

players.name: Kyle McCord
players.note: He is Miami's starter while Malik Willis is on IR (placed Nov. 10, groin/core muscle) for at least four games.

players.name: Daniel Jones
players.note: Sleeper shows he was released by IND as of 9:33 AM PT Nov 21; check his new role.

players.name: C.J. Stroud
players.note: He threw 3 TDs and 1 INT in the 26-3 TNF win over the Colts on Nov. 19. It was his third straight game with at least three TD passes.

players.name: Kenneth Walker III
players.note: Walker (groin) is listed out on Sleeper as of Nov. 20 for Sunday's Nov. 22 game vs. Arizona after missing practice all week. Andy Reid said the Chiefs won't rush him back.

players.name: Emmett Johnson
players.note: With Kenneth Walker III (groin) listed out, Johnson is in line to start a second straight game Nov. 22 vs. Arizona. He totaled 171 yards and 2 TDs in his Nov. 15 start at Atlanta.

players.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
players.note: Washington opened his IR practice window this week (groin, on IR since Oct. 19). He must be activated by Saturday, Nov. 21 to play Monday night vs. Cincinnati, and he would likely reclaim the lead role when he returns.

players.name: Rachaad White
players.note: Sleeper lists White questionable (heel) as of Nov. 20 ahead of Monday's game vs. Cincinnati. Jacory Croskey-Merritt's possible return from IR also threatens his early-down work.

players.name: Jordan James
players.note: Sleeper has listed James questionable (calf) since Nov. 19 ahead of San Francisco's Week 11 game. No practice details have been found.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.note: Montgomery (groin) came back on TNF Nov. 19 vs. the Colts and handled a workhorse load: 26 carries for 107 yards plus 3 catches for 17 yards. Woody Marks (concussion) was out.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.note: Marks (concussion) sat out TNF Nov. 19 while David Montgomery returned and took 26 carries. Marks projects as the backup once he clears protocol.

players.name: Seth McGowan
players.note: McGowan's offense role shrank on TNF Nov. 19 at Houston to 3 carries for 7 yards and 1 catch. Most of his work came on kick returns (3 for 117 yards).

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.note: Green Bay is on its Week 11 bye. Ian Rapoport reported Nov. 17 that Jacobs (finger) has a realistic chance to return Nov. 25 vs. the Rams.

players.name: Kaleb Johnson
players.note: Green Bay is on bye in Week 11, and Josh Jacobs (finger) could return Nov. 25 vs. the Rams (Rapoport, Nov. 17), which would likely end Johnson's run as the lead back.

players.name: Blake Corum
players.note: Corum out-carried Kyren Williams 17-12 on an even 39-39 snap split in Week 10 (Nov. 15), running for 100 yards and a TD. That points to a growing committee role.

players.name: Kyren Williams
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (toe) as of 3:17 PM PT Nov 21. Earlier: Williams managed only 12 carries for 23 yards in Week 10 (Nov. 15), and Blake Corum out-carried him on an even snap split. The Rams look like a committee.

players.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
players.note: Stevenson is playing through a knee issue. On Nov. 15 he had 6 carries for 4 yards on 26 of 59 snaps, and Corey Kiner out-carried him.

players.name: TreVeyon Henderson
players.note: The Patriots placed Henderson (illness) on IR on Nov. 14, so he will miss at least four games.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.note: Love (high ankle sprain) has been on IR since Nov. 3 and is expected to miss 4-5 weeks.

players.name: RJ Harvey
players.note: Harvey (knee) remains on IR. Jonah Coleman is established as Denver's lead back, so Harvey's role is likely to shrink when he returns.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.note: Bowers (ankle/quad) returned to practice Thursday, Nov 19, after a Wednesday DNP and is questionable for Sunday at Denver. Reports Nov 20 lean toward him playing, though some call it a game-time decision.

players.name: Michael Mayer
players.note: Mayer played 49 of 59 snaps in Week 10 after Bowers left. Bowers (questionable) practiced Thursday, Nov 19, and is leaning toward playing, so Mayer's Week 11 boost depends on Bowers sitting.

players.name: Dalton Kincaid
players.note: Kincaid (thumb/ankle) is listed doubtful for Week 11 vs. Miami on the Friday, Nov 20 report and is not expected to play. Dawson Knox would handle the lead TE role.

players.name: Darren Waller
players.note: Waller (knee) was limited Thursday and Friday (Nov 19-20) after a Wednesday DNP and is questionable for Sunday vs. Baltimore. Tommy Tremble (knee) is also questionable.

players.name: Jake Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson (knee sprain) was ruled out for Week 11 vs. Tennessee on the Nov 20 report. Brian Schottenheimer has said he will miss multiple weeks.

players.name: T.J. Hockenson
players.note: Hockenson (wrist/chest) has no designation on the final Week 11 report as of Nov 20 and is set to return after missing Week 10. Jordan Addison's thumb surgery could mean more targets for him.

players.name: Travis Kelce
players.note: The Chiefs placed TE Jared Wiley (ankle) on IR on Nov 18, which leaves Kelce with only Noah Gray and Jake Briningstool behind him. Kelce is off the injury report after playing just 20 snaps in Week 10.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.note: Ferguson (ankle/hamstring) remains on IR through the Rams' Week 11 bye. Sean McVay said on Nov 14 that he would miss 'another couple weeks', and Nov. 25 vs. Green Bay is the earliest likely return.

players.name: Tyler Higbee
players.note: Higbee played 51 of 76 snaps with a TD in Week 10 and stays the Rams' lead TE while Terrance Ferguson is on IR. The Rams are on bye in Week 11.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.note: Brown (hamstring, injured Nov 15) still had no reported imaging results or timeline as of Nov 21. New England is on its Week 11 bye, so Week 12 vs. the Chargers is the earliest he could return.

players.name: Carnell Tate
players.note: Tate (shoulder) was still limited in practice Thursday, Nov 19, per ESPN's Turron Davenport, and is at risk of missing a third straight game Sunday at Dallas. Sleeper lists him questionable.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.note: Thompson (hamstring) is listed doubtful for Week 11 vs. the Jets after missing three straight games and not practicing early in the week. A fourth straight absence is likely.

players.name: Drake London
players.note: Sleeper lists London questionable for Week 11 as of Nov 21. No details on the injury or his Friday practice status were found, so check inactives before Sunday.

players.name: Jauan Jennings
players.note: Jennings (calf) came off the injury report Nov 18 after missing two games. With Jordan Addison out after thumb surgery, he is in line for more targets in Week 11.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.note: Smith (hamstring) practiced fully Nov 19 and is off the injury report. He is set to return in Week 11 vs. Pittsburgh after missing three games.

players.name: Jaylen Waddle
players.note: Waddle (concussion) practiced fully Nov 18-19 and was off Sleeper's injury report as of Nov 20. He is on track to play Nov 22 vs. Las Vegas.

players.name: Chris Bell
players.note: Bell (knee) was limited Nov 18-19 after missing Week 10, but he was off Sleeper's injury report as of Nov 20. He appears set to return Sunday vs. Buffalo.

players.name: Caleb Douglas
players.note: Douglas (shoulder) was off Sleeper's injury report as of Nov 20 and is expected to play Sunday vs. Buffalo. Chris Bell's return threatens his expanded role.

players.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
players.note: Samuel caught a TD in his Nov 15 return, playing 44 of 65 snaps. Mike Evans (Achilles) was back in uniform at practice Nov 19, but reports say he may not be ready for Week 11, so Samuel's target share is safe for now.

players.name: Brandon Aiyuk
players.note: Aiyuk remains on reserve/left squad with his reinstatement reportedly held up by a bonus-forfeiture dispute. No activation had been confirmed as of Nov 21.

players.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
players.note: With Elijah Sarratt a healthy scratch, Lane drew 11 targets Nov 16 vs. the Chargers and caught 3 for 61 yards. He is now ahead of Sarratt in Baltimore's rotation.

players.name: Elijah Sarratt
players.note: Sarratt was a coach's-decision inactive Nov 16 while Ja'Kobi Lane took an 11-target role. His spot in Baltimore's rotation is in question for Week 11.

players.name: Cyrus Allen
players.note: Allen played only 23 of 65 snaps Nov 15 in Josh Downs' Chiefs debut, though he caught a TD. Downs pushes him down the target pecking order.

players.name: Deion Burks
players.note: Burks started on TNF at Houston on Nov 19 but did not catch any of his 3 targets, his second straight game without a catch despite the open Colts WR depth chart.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.note: Adams (hamstring, IR) is targeting a return around Weeks 12-13, after the Rams' Week 11 bye.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.note: Pierce (heel) has been on IR since Week 3. On Nov 11, Shane Steichen said he was unsure whether Pierce will return in 2026.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.note: Addison (thumb) is out for Week 11 vs. San Francisco after thumb surgery, and he is expected to miss multiple weeks. As of Nov 20 the Vikings had not put him on IR.

players.name: Justin Jefferson
players.note: With Addison (thumb surgery) out for Week 11 and beyond, Jefferson keeps a heavy-volume WR1 role vs. San Francisco in Mexico City. Jauan Jennings is the next man up behind him.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.note: Evans (Achilles tendinitis) was limited Thursday and Friday, his first practices after missing three games, and is questionable vs. Minnesota. On Nov 20 Shanahan said he was sore but trending the right way, and a final call comes Saturday before the team leaves for Mexico.

players.name: Keenan Allen
players.note: Allen's Week 11 role vs. Minnesota depends on Mike Evans (questionable, decision Saturday Nov 21). If Evans sits, Allen should stay a regular in the rotation after his 5-61 debut on Nov 15.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.note: McConkey (back) was limited all three days and was listed questionable on Nov 20 for Sunday vs. the Jets after missing two games. He looks more likely than not to play, but he carries a real risk of leaving early.

players.name: Tre' Harris
players.note: McConkey (back) is questionable after three limited practices (Nov 20). If he sits, Harris keeps the key role he used for 5-86 on Nov 16. If McConkey plays, Harris's share likely shrinks.

players.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
players.note: Aaron Glenn ruled Cooper (ankle/hip) out for Week 11 vs. the Chargers on Nov 20, after he missed every practice this week. It was his third ankle injury this year, and he could miss multiple weeks, which opens the No. 2 role for Adonai Mitchell.

players.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
players.note: Pittman (foot) returned to practice from IR and is listed questionable for Sunday at Philadelphia. He is still on the reserve list, so he must be activated by 4 PM ET Saturday, Nov 21, to play.

players.name: Roman Wilson
players.note: Sleeper now lists him questionable (hand) as of 3:17 PM PT Nov 21. Earlier: Wilson (hand) practiced fully all three days in his IR window and is listed questionable for Sunday at Philadelphia. The Steelers must activate him by 4 PM ET Saturday, Nov 21, and they have two open roster spots.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.note: On Nov 20 McVay said Nacua had MCL surgery on Tuesday and will be out a couple of months. Asked whether that ends his regular season, McVay said 'you can pretty much say yes.' Nacua is also serving a three-game NFL suspension.

players.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
players.note: Harrison (hamstring) missed the Nov 19 TNF game, his second straight absence, and has not practiced since before Week 9. Houston has a bye next, so his earliest return is Nov 29 vs. Baltimore.

players.name: Makai Lemon
players.note: DeVonta Smith practiced fully all week and is off the Eagles' injury report for Sunday vs. Pittsburgh, per Nov 20 reports. Lemon has drawn 27% of the team's targets over the past month as the fill-in WR1, so his volume likely dips.

players.name: Pat Bryant
players.note: Jaylen Waddle (concussion) is set to return in Week 11 after practicing fully following the bye, per Nov 20 reports. Bryant should still play a big role, but his target ceiling probably drops.

players.name: Luther Burden III
players.note: Burden cleared the concussion protocol and logged three full practices this week. He carries no designation for Sunday vs. New Orleans (Nov 20).

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.note: Tyson (chest) practiced fully Friday, Nov 20, and has no designation for Sunday at Chicago. Kellen Moore said the team will keep increasing his workload.

players.name: Zachariah Branch
players.note: Branch (hamstring, Week 8) still had not been reported practicing as of Nov 20. Atlanta's Week 11 bye gives him extra time to recover.

players.name: Tyreek Hill
players.note: Hill is still unsigned and not yet medically cleared after his ACL tear. Agent Drew Rosenhaus says teams can sign him once he is cleared, and as of Nov 20 prediction markets list the Bills as favorites (44%).

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.note: Doubs (shoulder) remains on IR during New England's Week 11 bye. No return date had been reported as of Nov 20.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.note: Wilson is out for the season after fracturing his neck on Nov 8 vs. Seattle.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.note: McLaurin is out for the 2026 season after tearing his left patellar tendon on Oct 19.

players.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:16 PM PT Nov 20. Earlier: Rodriguez (hand) was a limited practice participant again Wednesday, Nov. 18, and remains questionable for Jacksonville's Week 11 game. He has played through the hand issue before.

players.name: Bhayshul Tuten
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:16 PM PT Nov 20. Earlier: Sleeper has listed Tuten questionable (ankle) since Nov. 18 ahead of Jacksonville's Week 11 game, and no practice update has been found yet. Friday's final designation will decide his availability.

players.name: Kyle Monangai
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:34 PM PT Nov 18. Earlier: Monangai (toe) has been upgraded to questionable on Sleeper (Nov. 18) after Chicago's Week 10 bye. D'Andre Swift remains the lead back.

players.name: Adam Randall
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was on injured reserve) as of 12:32 PM PT Nov 18. Earlier: Randall remains on IR after not playing Nov. 16 vs. the Chargers. His practice window opened in late October, so an activation decision is due soon.

players.name: Geno Smith
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:16 PM PT Nov 20. Earlier: He was limited in practice on Wednesday and Thursday (Nov. 18-19) with a left-ankle injury. He says he plans to play, and the Jets believe he can start Sunday at the Chargers.

players.name: Jakobi Meyers
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:16 PM PT Nov 20. Earlier: Meyers was limited with an ankle injury Nov 18; he has played through the injury for several weeks. Jacksonville faces the Giants Sunday.

players.name: Isaiah Likely
players.note: Cleared: no longer on Sleeper's injury report (was questionable) as of 6:16 PM PT Nov 20.

players.name: Dontayvion Wicks
players.note: Sleeper now lists him on injured reserve (ankle) as of 3:17 PM PT Nov 21.
